title: Pi exact Code-Kit runtime contract port with observation mapping

argv: from pathlib import Path; p=Path(r'tests/test_runtime_contract_port.py'); assert p.exists() and p.stat().st_size>0; print('PI_RUNTIME_PORT_ARTIFACT_OK')

from sentinelmesh.runtime import ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS, LIFECYCLE, InvocationSpec, ProcessIdentity, Lifecycle, classify_start, reconcile, validate_argv; assert LIFECYCLE == ('NEW','STARTING','STARTED','STOPPING','STOPPED','FAILED','START_UNKNOWN'); assert ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS['START_UNKNOWN'] == {'STARTED','STOPPING','FAILED'}; assert tuple(validate_argv(['python','', 'x\n'])) == ('python','','x\n'); print('PI_RUNTIME_PORT_API_OK')

definition_of_done.text: 逐项实现 canonical Code-Kit runtime 常量、RuntimeErrorCode/旧 RuntimeErrorSM 兼容、validate_argv、InvocationSpec.digest、四字段 ProcessIdentity 和 frozen Lifecycle.transition(expected_generation)。

classify_start 解析 run_id/environment_sha256/state/process_identity 并区分 NOT_STARTED/STARTED/START_UNKNOWN/IDENTITY_MISMATCH；reconcile(expected InvocationSpec, observed Mapping) 返回 status/run_id/expected_environment_sha256/observed_environment_sha256/replay_allowed 五键 mapping。
START_UNKNOWN 只有 generation fence 后可恢复；身份不匹配、stale generation、未知/不完整 cleanup、非终止状态不能 replay；终止且 identity match、cleanup_confirmed 才可 replay。

测试直接使用 Code-Kit 调用形状，覆盖 ordinary empty/newline args、C1/surrogate/NUL、constructor immediate validation、digest、Lifecycle transitions/generation、start observation mismatch、reconcile mapping/replay gate 和旧运行 API。
无依赖、无凭据/联网/真实 provider；native Windows/macOS process cleanup 仍 NOT_RUN/BLOCKED。
